reviewer_policy: No cloud judge. Agent annotations are provisional, never counted as independent human judgments.
hard_gates: Reproducible identity and recorded operational errors
All displayed references resolve to exact presented snapshot excerpts
No invalid draft exposed; technical failure distinct from insufficient evidence

utility.1: Partly correct/useful, scope gaps or uncertainty problems
utility.2: Correct, covers requested scope, coherent dates and honest uncertainty

review_units: planner facets, redundancy and unnecessary split
retrieval: Recall@10 and nDCG@10 only against explicitly graded pool; unknown is unjudged, never silently irrelevant. Exclude no-positive/insufficient cases from recall denominator. Report pool coverage.
acceptance: Operational gates fixed before held-out generation; no post-hoc accuracy threshold or tuning on held-out cases.
